description: Start with an empty board and manually place pieces — a queen on d4 and a knight on f6.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_chess import Board

class ChessBoardAddPiece(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        board = Board()
        board.add_piece('Q', True, 'd4')
        board.add_piece('N', False, 'f6')
        board.add_piece('K', True, 'e1')
        board.add_piece('K', False, 'e8')
        self.add(board)
        self.wait(0.5)
